title: Object Identification Drill
description: Scan horizontal ground surface, tap to place equipment, then identify and inspect the target monitor.

steps.title: Target Equipment Identification
steps.instructionEn: Locate and tap on the highlighted safety gas monitor.
steps.instructionHi: हाइलाइट किए गए सुरक्षा गैस मॉनिटर को पहचानें और उस पर टैप करें।
steps.instructionSat: ᱪᱤᱱᱦᱟᱹᱣ ᱢᱮ ᱟᱨ ᱥᱩᱨᱚᱠᱷᱤᱛ ᱜᱮᱥ ᱢᱚᱱᱤᱴᱚᱨ ᱪᱮᱛᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱴᱤᱯ ᱢᱮ (Gas monitor ñel kate tip me).
steps.hintText: Move your camera within 1.5 meters of the equipment box and tap it directly.
